<Subject 3> is the visibly snowy mountain pavilion terrace in <Picture 3>: rear-left dark wooden pavilion with snow-covered eaves, snow-capped stone balustrade along rear and right, open terrace with a light settled snow layer, snow-laden pine at right and white distant mountain ridges. detailed_description:
The supplied opening guide anchors the actual previous end frame at time zero. Continue without repeating completed actions or dialogue.
The target video retains the same semi-realistic guofeng adult characters, soft winter afternoon light, and landscape composition. These ten seconds immediately follow the preceding shot with continuous gentle snowfall.
[Shot 1] Begin from the supplied actual preceding end frame, preserving the positions of <Subject 1> on the left and <Subject 2> on the right in <Subject 3>. The woman has her anatomical LEFT palm open at lower chest height and her right hand relaxed near her waist. The man's anatomical RIGHT fingers already lightly touch the top of her left wrist, while his left hand stays lowered. Both look down toward her palm. Preserve this existing contact, hand height, spacing, snow dusting and gaze from the actual guide; never reset his right hand to his side or repeat the completed reach. Keep the snow-covered railing across the background, the pavilion edge at left and snow-laden pine toward right. Snowflakes remain visible both in front of the couple and against the dark posts behind them, with the same gentle density and diagonal drift as before.
During the first three seconds, a few naturally falling flakes settle onto the woman's open palm and melt into tiny glints of moisture. She notices this small change with a fond, slightly wistful expression, not distress. Her palm stays open and steady. The camera holds the guide's established closer medium two-shot, still showing both faces and their touching hands; there is no cut to an isolated hand or change of screen side. Her ivory and pale-celadon sleeve hangs below her wrist, retaining its original embroidery.
From second three to six, <Subject 2> (S2) looks at her and replies gently in warm, medium-low adult male Mandarin, <d>[Chinese] 好，我陪你.</d> His lips close at the end of the short sentence. His expression is calm and affectionate. As the reply ends, his anatomical RIGHT fingers slide gently from the top of her left wrist around to support the underside of her open hand. This is a small adjustment of existing contact, not a new reach. Keep his other hand lowered and her right hand separate near her waist.
During seconds six through nine, he gently supports her left hand from underneath with his right palm. She accepts the contact and glances up toward his face, her shoulders relaxing. Their fingers remain anatomically distinct, lightly resting rather than interlocking in a complicated grip. Soft cloth movement accompanies the gesture. Finish with their joined hands supported between them at lower chest height and both faces visible. Neither person repeats the opening request. Snow continues falling throughout, accumulating only subtly on hair and shoulders; the settled snow on architecture does not vanish. Wind and the quiet instrumental theme carry smoothly into the next segment.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous soft mountain wind and distant pine rustle, with natural cloth movement during gestures. Snow falls quietly; no rain or storm sounds. Continue the preceding ambient bed without restarting it or repeating previous transient effects. Synchronized gesture sounds and any dialogue occur only at their described moments.

non_diegetic_music:
Continue a quiet instrumental guqin and airy bamboo-flute theme at approximately 68 BPM, warm and tender, sparse notes, no vocals or percussion. Keep it below dialogue and delicate gesture sounds. Preserve the same musical character and leave the phrase open at the ending; do not add an opening flourish or final cadence.
